About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Business Analyst who is a Manufacturing Functional Expert. This is not a general Supply Chain position. We need someone who understands how a manufacturing company works day to day and can set up D365 to support it.

You will be the link between our clients' manufacturing teams and our technical team. You will understand what the client needs, design the right solution in D365, and guide the project from start to go-live and beyond.

What You Will Do

Understand clients' manufacturing needs and turn them into clear, practical solutions in D365.
Lead workshops and discussions with clients to review their current processes and identify where D365 fits and where it does not.
Prepare clear project documents, including business requirements, functional requirements, functional designs and process flows.
Set up and implement the Production, Planning, Warehouse, Quality, Inventory and Inventory Costing areas of D365.
Recommend solutions that use standard D365 features and follow industry best practice, and explain the business impact of any gaps.
Work with the technical team on customizations and integrations, and make sure the final solution meets the client's needs.
Support data migration, system testing and user acceptance testing, and make sure issues are resolved.
Train client users, prepare user guides and help the client's team adopt the new system.
Support go-live and look after the client after go-live.
Keep clients informed, manage their expectations and build strong working relationships.
Work with onshore and offshore teams to deliver on time and with quality.
Flag project risks and process issues early, and suggest practical ways to resolve them.
Where applicable, support MES implementation.

Expertise We Require

The candidate must have strong, proven project experience in the following areas of D365 F&O:

Production – managing how products are made: bills of materials, production routes, production orders, scheduling and production costs.
Planning – deciding what to produce and buy, how much and when, based on demand, stock levels and production capacity.
Warehouse Management (WMS / Advanced Warehouse Management) – running the warehouse efficiently: receiving, storing, picking and moving raw materials and finished goods.
Quality – checking quality at receiving, during production and before shipping, and handling products that fail checks.
Inventory Management – keeping accurate stock records, tracking batches and serial numbers, stock counts and adjustments.
Inventory Costing – valuing stock correctly using methods such as standard cost, FIFO and weighted average, and ensuring production costs flow accurately into finance.

Experience and Skills Required

4+ years of experience in D365 F&O or Dynamics AX as a functional consultant, with a strong focus on manufacturing.
Experience in at least two end-to-end D365 F&O manufacturing implementations, from requirements through to go-live and support.
Proven expertise in Production, Planning, Warehouse Management (WMS), Quality, Inventory Management and Inventory Costing.
Strong understanding of manufacturing business processes and how they connect to finance and costing.
Strong skills in business analysis, documentation, solution design and client communication.
Ability to work independently and collaborate well with teams in different locations.

Good to Have

Having experience in MES (Manufacturing Execution System) implementation will be an added advantage. An MES helps run and track production on the shop floor in real time. Experience in any of the following is valuable:

Setting up shop floor systems so operators can start and stop jobs, report output and record materials used.
Capturing real-time information on labor, machine time, scrap and downtime, and reflecting it accurately in production and cost records.
Connecting MES with D365 production, inventory and quality processes.
Training shop floor users and supporting testing and go-live.
Experience in Product Information Management, Procurement and Sales modules.

Conduct comprehensive penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on computer systems, networks, and applications.

Provides assistance to Operations team for debugging, exploitation and vulnerability analysis.
Contributes to the design of penetration test report deliverables, constantly evaluating effectiveness of report outline.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
At least 2-5 years of experience in penetration testing and vulnerability assessments, with a focus on web applications, networks, and infrastructure.
Experienced with programming/scripting languages (e.g.: Python, Bash, Rust)
In-depth knowledge of various penetration testing tools, frameworks and OS (e.g., Kali Linux, Metasploit, Burp Suite, Nmap, Wireshark, etc.).

Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems

Develop updated training package to the TYCOM and to the RMCs. Provide formal on-board operator and maintenance training to Ship’s Force.

Manage personnel as required to support short-term and long-term contract efforts.
Cultivating positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Five years’ supervisory experience in the area of technical assistance, maintenance, or design related to surface ships.

Two years direct experience with auxiliary, electrical and damage control systems for U.S. Naval Ships.
Two years of supervisory experience.

Knowledge of best practice maritime processes and support methodologies to meet Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) requirements.
Ability to lead and manage large teams.
Ability to operate personal computers and have good knowledge and operational abilities with Microsoft Office tools.

Fastmarkets is an industry-leading price-reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, providing price data, news, analytics and events for the agriculture, forest products, metals and mining and new-generation energy markets.

Fastmarkets' data is critical for customers seeking to understand and predict dynamic, sometimes opaque markets, enabling trading and risk management. Fastmarkets is a global business with a history dating back to 1865 and is built on trust and deep market knowledge. It has more than 700 employees spread across global locations in the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Bulgaria, Finland and beyond.

Job Description

The Role

The Business Analyst will work closely with the product, business and technology teams to identify and resolve gaps in requirements to address business problems and customer needs. The role will combine strong business analysis practice with practical use of artificial intelligence to improve the speed, quality and consistency of discovery, requirements definition, process design and delivery.

This role will help the business lean further into AI-driven ways of working. It will identify where AI, automation and better use of data can remove low-value manual activity, improve decision-making and create better customer and colleague experiences. The Business Analyst will test opportunities responsibly, show measurable value and help teams adopt new approaches while maintaining appropriate human oversight, information security and data quality.

Analyse and improve business processes to drive efficiency, scalability and customer value.

Identify, test and champion practical uses of AI and automation that help teams work smarter while maintaining appropriate governance and oversight.

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully.

If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

Knowledge, Experience And Skills

Strong business analysis skills across discovery, requirements, process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria and UAT.
Experience using AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, documentation and automation while validating outputs.

Collaborate with data engineering teams and system owners to improve integrations, transformations, data accessibility, and quality checks.

Handle confidential financial, HR, and payroll information with discretion, accuracy, and a strong commitment to data protection.

At least 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, financial analytics, FP&A analytics, or a related analytical role.

Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both Finance and technical stakeholders.
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly.
A rigorous, curious, and structured approach to data quality, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and make definitions explicit.
Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and deliver practical solutions in a changing business environment.

Experience in a B2B SaaS, software, technology, or scale-up environment.
Familiarity with SaaS revenue metrics, including MRR, ARR, NRR, churn, and bookings.
Understanding of SaaS cost structures, including cloud storage, compute, data retention, AI-related expenses, and gross margin.
Experience with finance, accounting, billing, CRM, HRIS, payroll, expense-management, or financial planning tools.
Knowledge of data warehouses, data modeling, ETL processes, APIs, or data quality frameworks.
Experience with Python or another programming language for analysis and automation.
Previous exposure to sensitive HR or payroll data and an understanding of the confidentiality requirements involved.

new_jobs.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager
to lead the cross-functional development and delivery of complex silicon photonics systems from engineering development through system integration, qualification, manufacturing, and production. This role will coordinate execution across silicon photonics, hardware, firmware, software, mechanical/thermal engineering, systems engineering, test, supply chain, and manufacturing
, while managing dependencies with vendors and external partners. The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with disciplined program execution and has experience delivering complex hardware/software products through the full product lifecycle.

Lead integrated program planning and execution across silicon photonics, HW, FW, SW, system integration, test, and manufacturing.

new_jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of experience in program or project management.
Experience managing extended workforce programs or vendor relationships.
Experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering operations initiatives, including resource management, planning, and programs.

Preferred qualifications:

8 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

The Search Engineering Operations team mission is to accelerate Search Engineering through effective outsourced programs.

As a Senior Program Manager (PgM) with Search Operations, you will lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering operations initiatives, leveraging your functional expertise with a strong emphasis on resource optimization, strategic planning, and operational efficiency programs. You will proactively identify, organize, and guide portfolio activities and key stakeholders to deliver scalable operational solutions. You will scope, structure, and drive ambiguous cross-functional and cross-organizational programs, including executing end-to-end change management alongside cross-functional partners. Additionally, you will ensure alignment among executive stakeholders and bring deep domain expertise to advance strategic program goals.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $188000 - $274000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Serve as a strategic thought partner to search operations leadership, advising on operational direction and leading supplier management.
Engage and liaise with cross-functional senior leadership across Extended Workforce Solutions (xWS), Search Operations, GPO, Finance, and gTech to build alignment for strategic initiatives and serve as search operations.
Drive operational excellence through regular reviews with product leadership, managing Search operations spend against budgets and identifying ongoing opportunities to support product area-wide priorities.
Lead and enable vendor management teams with AI-first solutions to improve efficiency and effectiveness across core workstreams, including contracting lifecycles, purchase order and invoice management, and access management.
